_about: Public-domain Burnett Hillman Streeter (1874-1937), Oxford New Testament scholar and Provost of Queen's, for the Word Hoard: Restatement and Reunion, War this War and the Sermon on the Mount, Woman and the Church (with Edith Picton-Turbervill), The Sadhu (with A. J. Appasamy), The Four Gospels, Reality, Moral Adventure and The Primitive Church, all printed before 1930. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 85 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

streeter-restatement-reunion: Restatement and reunion : a study in first principles (London : Macmillan and Co., 1914)
streeter-war-sermon-mount: War, this war and the sermon on the mount (London, New York [etc.] H. Milford, 1915)
streeter-sadhu: The Sadhu: a study in mysticism and practical religion (London, Macmillan and co., limited, 1921)
streeter-four-gospels: The four Gospels; a study of origins, treating of the manuscript tradition, sources, authorship, & dates, vol. 1925 (New York, Macmillan Co., 1925)
streeter-reality: Reality; a new correlation of science and religion (New York : The Macmillan company, 1926)

_excluded.streeter-symposia: Foundations (1912), Concerning Prayer, Immortality (1917), The Spirit (1919), God and the Struggle for Existence (1919) and Adventure (1927): many-author volumes he edited or contributed to
_excluded.streeter-after-1929: The Buddha and the Christ (1932) and later
